verdict.rationale: BILL Spend & Expense markets AI-powered spend management that categorizes transactions automatically and 'controls' spend as it happens (doc-9), plus real-time webhook event notifications for S&E events (docs-3, docs-16) and organization structure APIs that could map to teams (docs-5). However, there is no direct evidence of a founder-facing real-time dashboard or report broken down explicitly by team, category, and merchant — most evidence is developer/API-platform oriented rather than describing the actual spend-visibility UI. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/screenshots of a real-time spend dashboard segmented by team/category/merchant, and independent/user corroboration of same-day visibility.
